g.text: Unified Smart Lighting Controller Hub & Hardware Bridges
ESP32 MULTI-LINK CONTROLLER // 940nm IR DRIVER // WI-FI DESK LAMP RETROFIT // 433.92MHz RF REMOTE MATRIX
CIRCUIT A: HIGH-POWER OPTICAL IR EMITTER DRIVER (38 kHz MODULATED)
CIRCUIT B: WI-FI RETROFITTED DESK LAMP (ESP8266 HARDWARE ADAPTATION)
CIRCUIT C: LM3046 NPN ARRAY // 433.92 MHz RF REMOTE INTERFACE
Replaces 2x AAA Battery (3.0V) directly from ESP32

svg.text: +3.3V SPLICED POWER RAIL (POWERS 433 MHz RF BOARD DIRECTLY FROM ESP32)

g.text: 10 kΩ pull-downs eliminate bootloader float to prevent RF latching. 470 Ω base limiter saturates 2N2222 for peak 940nm IR range. ESP8266 Wi-Fi bridge pulses soldered lamp power terminals.
